scenes.title: A Home Filled with Faith
scenes.english_text: In the town of Lystra, there lived a godly grandmother named Lois and her faithful daughter, Eunice. Though living in a culture with many different beliefs, they filled their home with love, prayer, and devotion to God. Together, they cherished the Holy Scriptures and passed down a sincere, pure faith from generation to generation.
scenes.tetum_translation: Iha sidade Listra, hela avó-feto ida ne'ebé ta'uk Maromak naran Loide no nia oan-feto laran-metin, Eunice. Maski hela iha kultura ida ne'ebé ho fiar oin-oin, sira hanoin metin sira-nia uma ho domin, orasaun, no dedikasaun ba Maromak. Sira hamutuk valoriza Kuaresma (Eskritura Sante) no haraik fiar ne'ebé laran-moos husi gerasaun ba gerasaun.
scenes.scene_summary: Grandmother Lois and mother Eunice live a godly life in Lystra, cultivating sincere faith at home.

scenes.title: Teaching Young Timothy the Scriptures
scenes.english_text: Eunice gave birth to a sweet boy named Timothy. From the time he was a small child, Lois and Eunice patiently taught Timothy the ancient Scriptures every single day. They read holy stories, recited verses, and explained God's wisdom, instilling in Timothy's heart a deep love for God's truth.
scenes.tetum_translation: Eunice mós hanoin hetan oan-mane kmas ida naran Timóteo. Husi tempu nia kianuk kikiik, Loide no Eunice ho pasiénsia hanorin Timóteo Eskritura Sante sira loron-loron. Sira lee istória santu sira, dekora versíklu sira, no esplika Maromak nia sabedoria, hodi kuda iha Timóteo nia laran domin kle'an ba Maromak nia lian loolos.
scenes.scene_summary: Lois and Eunice lovingly teach young Timothy the Holy Scriptures from his early childhood.

scenes.title: Welcoming Apostle Paul into Their Home
scenes.english_text: When Apostle Paul visited Lystra during his missionary journey, he met Lois, Eunice, and young Timothy. Paul noticed the genuine, unfeigned faith that first lived in grandmother Lois and mother Eunice, and now burned brightly in Timothy. Paul rejoiced seeing how faithful training at home produced a wonderful young disciple.
scenes.tetum_translation: Bainhira Apostolu Paulu visita sidade Listra iha nia viajen misionáriu, nia konese Loide, Eunice, no Timóteo nurak. Paulu nota fiar loosi no kle'an ne'ebé moris uluk iha avó Loide no inan Eunice, no agora lakan nabilan iha Timóteo laran. Paulu haksolok boot haree oinsá hanorin laran-metin iha uma gasta oan-mane misionáriu furak ida.
scenes.scene_summary: Paul visits Lystra and recognizes the genuine faith passed down from Lois and Eunice to Timothy.
scenes.nano_banana_prompt: Nano Banana illustration style, Apostle Paul in a traveling cloak greeting grandmother Lois, mother Eunice, and young Timothy warmly outside their home under olive trees. Whimsical fairytale picture book watercolor texture, rich vibrant pastel colors, no text, 4:3 aspect ratio.

scenes.title: Blessing Timothy for Mission Work
scenes.english_text: Recognizing Timothy's spiritual maturity and good reputation, Paul invited Timothy to join him in spreading the Gospel. Though it was hard to let him go, Lois and Eunice selflessly prayed over Timothy, blessed him, and sent him out to serve God. Their faithful investment at home was now bearing fruit for the entire world.
scenes.tetum_translation: Reconese Timóteo nia brani espiritual no reputasaun di'ak, Paulu konvida Timóteo atu belun ho nia lori lia-foun di'ak (Evanjellu). Maski susar atu husik nia ba, Loide no Eunice ho laran-luak harohan ba Timóteo, haraik bensaun ba nia, no haruka nia sai atu serbí Maromak. Sira-nia serbisu laran-metin iha uma agora fo foliage ba raiklaran hotu.
scenes.scene_summary: Lois and Eunice selflessly bless Timothy and send him off to serve as Paul's missionary partner.

scenes.title: A Lasting Legacy of Generational Faith
scenes.english_text: Years later, Paul wrote letters encouraging Timothy, remembering the sincere faith of his mother Eunice and grandmother Lois. Their quiet, daily dedication to teaching God's Word at home transformed Timothy into a great leader of the early church. Their story reminds us that a godly family leaves a legacy of faith that endures forever.
scenes.tetum_translation: Tinan balu tuir mai, Paulu hakerek surat sira atu fo ksolok ba Timóteo, hodi hanoin hetan fiar moos husi nia inan Eunice no avó Loide. Sira-nia dedikasaun ne'e loron-loron iha uma transforma Timóteo sai lidun boot iha Kreda baisekur. Sira-nia istória fó hanoin mai ita katak família kmas sobakar haraik eransa fiar ne'ebé nabilan ba nafatin.
scenes.scene_summary: The legacy of Lois and Eunice's faithful teaching lives on through Timothy's leadership in the early church.

reflection.core_lesson_en: Lois and Eunice teach us that sharing God's truth and love at home builds a powerful foundation of faith that shapes future generations.
reflection.core_lesson_tet: Loide no Eunice hanorin mai ita katak fahe Maromak nia lian no domin iha uma harii fundasaun fiar forte ne'ebé kria gerasaun futuru sira.
reflection.discussion_question_en: How can you share God's word and pray together with your family or friends at home every day?
reflection.discussion_question_tet: Oinsá ó bele fahe Maromak nia lian no harohan hamutuk ho ó-nia família ka belun sira iha uma loron-loron?
